title: Choose the visual world
question: Your brief pins the world (manuscripts, botanical archives, tactile paper, warm neutrals). The roll chose which form of that world to build: The Formulary. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Formulary
options.lineage: 19th-century pharmacopoeias and dispensatories: thumb-indexed, rubricated, annotated in the margins
options.thesis: The store is a reference book: every product is a numbered entry, and every skin concern is a thumb-tab on the fore-edge.
options.viewport: An open spread with a running head. The lead entry is rubricated and has a working Add to bag. Concern tabs run down the right edge.
options.risk: If the book metaphor goes beyond its navigation it turns into a costume; the tabs and entries have to do real shopping work.

raised.raise: Entries sit on a fixed ledger grid; price and stock change in place without reflowing the row.
Each margin note draws a ruled leader to the one ingredient line that matters.
Every product has an entry number that is also its address (No. 041 → /entry/041).
Only three inks: ink, rubric and bookcloth. Out of stock prints as an empty ruled box.
Product plates are tipped in on their own plane and lift a millimetre toward the cursor.
Margin notes ink in as the pointer approaches their entry.

options.label: Herbarium Sheet
options.lineage: museum herbarium sheets with collector’s labels and linen strapping
options.thesis: Each product is mounted like a pressed specimen, with its collector’s label.
options.viewport: One large mounted sheet: the hero product strapped to the board, with an accession label (name, brand, price, add to bag) in the bottom right.
options.risk: This is the literal reading of the brief and where most runs land. It also shows only one product at a time, which slows browsing.

options.label: Split-flap Concourse
options.thesis: The catalogue as a departure board, with restocks and new arrivals flipping in.
options.viewport: A board of product rows: brand, product, size, price, status.
options.risk: Transit urgency fights the slow, considered register the brief asks for.
options.case: It fuses mechanically but shoppers don't see skincare as departures, and it loses the botanical archive entirely.
options.kept: Rows keep a fixed grid, so state changes never reflow the page.

options.label: Hand-drawn Zine
options.thesis: Skincare routines taught in a doodled comic.
options.viewport: A doodled routine diagram with arrows to each product.
options.risk: Too playful for a premium multi-brand retailer.
options.case: Clear on routines but off-register for a premium retailer.
options.kept: Annotation that points: each note leads to the line that matters.

options.label: Teletext Pages
options.viewport: A P100 index of brands with product page numbers.
options.risk: Retro novelty; no warmth or tactility.
options.case: It works as an addressing system but can't carry the paper and botanical world.
options.kept: Numbered addressing: each product has a number that is also its URL.

options.label: Kiosk Print
options.thesis: Every brand reprinted in one office’s three inks.
options.viewport: A kiosk grid of product cells, each with one abstract mark.
options.risk: Overwrites the brands' own packaging, which breaks the neutral-host principle.
options.case: It would erase the brands it should frame.
options.kept: A restricted ink set, and out-of-stock shown as an empty ruled box.

options.label: Multiplane Dawn
options.thesis: A painted forest you scroll down through, layer by layer.
options.viewport: Layered painted forest with products on the nearest cel.
options.risk: Spectacle over shopping, with heavy asset needs.
options.case: Atmospheric, but products get lost inside the painting.
options.kept: Real depth planes: images and text move on separate layers.

options.label: Luminous Understory
options.thesis: Botany reinvented as light that responds to attention.
options.viewport: A dark understory where products glow as the pointer nears them.
options.risk: Dark neon breaks the warm-neutral brief.
options.case: It contradicts the pinned warm neutrals.
options.kept: Proximity as attention: elements wake as the pointer approaches.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The premium skincare storefront, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: A full-bleed lifestyle hero, then a shop-by-category row and a bestsellers grid.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
